created_before: wave3 fits and wave3 development scoring
continuation_clause_clarified_before: wave4 development scoring and before any seed947 fit or official-test feature/label access
leaf_refit_clause_clarified_before: Any real-data leaf-correction solve, seed947 fit, or official-test feature/label access
temperature_clause_clarified_before: Any real-data temperature candidate evaluation, seed947 fit, or official-test feature/label access
trigger: The first cumulative development wave to meet its predeclared target against both XGBoost and LightGBM; if its seed check fails, a later separately predeclared continuation that passes the original gate also receives this fixed-config seed check. Preserve every failed check.
datasets: All 12 frozen metadata-selected tasks; no exclusions based on results.
configuration_policy: For each dataset and library, refit exactly the selected configuration from the successful cumulative wave. Retain its original round cap and the same primary-metric early stopping patience of50, changing only the learner seed. If the selected policy includes a fixed-topology regression leaf correction, recompute that same fixed penalty/shrinkage correction on TRAIN only after fitting the new-seed tree model, using the checked ordered training transform. No extra configuration search, reselection, or replacement using development scores.
temperature_policy: If a multiclass policy includes a selected positive temperature, reuse that exact temperature on the new-seed model without re-selection. Apply the shared float64 margin/temperature helper to both seeds in development and official-test scoring; include its operation in any end-to-end latency claim. Native trees remain unchanged.
data_policy: Use the same existing training and stopping roles. Development remains a separate scoring role. This checks learner-seed sensitivity on reused data, not independence of the datasets or split.
aggregation: For each dataset and library, average the primary error of the original seed47 model and seed947 model. Compute CTBoost relative error gains against each comparator from these per-dataset means. Report 12 datasets, never 24 independent observations. Also report each seed separately.
if_gate_fails: Preserve the failed result, keep official outer test sealed, and continue only under a newly frozen development protocol with equal additional candidate budgets for all three libraries.

official_test_after_gate.authorization: Root confirmed the user authorized a one-shot official outer-test assessment after policy freeze.
official_test_after_gate.split: Original OpenML task repeat0, fold0, sample0 outer-test rows, uncapped.
official_test_after_gate.preconditions: Freeze the final configuration policy, script/native identities, both-seed model file hashes, and local dataset/split file hashes before loading test features or labels.
official_test_after_gate.models: Score the already trained seed47 and seed947 models. No refit on train+stop or full outer training; no adaptation after observing test results.
official_test_after_gate.labels: Use the classification label ordering learned from official outer-training labels; verify it matches the cached training-role labels. Regression labels unchanged.
official_test_after_gate.aggregation: Same two-seed mean error per dataset and 12-task aggregation as development. Preserve all per-task and per-seed outcomes and failures.
official_test_after_gate.limitations: Bounded exploratory comparison using partial outer-training data and a small adaptive development portfolio. This is not a full TabArena run, Elo score, proof of universal superiority, or validation of a new default. Original14 failed-gate confirmation fold7 stays sealed.
